title: THE HIDDEN DOOR
location: L11 · OLD OBSERVATORY WING → PASSAGE (L12 approach)
tod: 13:45 · the sun has moved off the old wing entirely
logline: Two boys step out of the day and into a corridor that was built for something the world has forgotten.
grade: Progressive desaturation. By the end of the scene, the only saturated colour left in the frame is the blue. Skin tones stay warm — protect them or the characters will look dead.

narration.hi: मैंने किसी को नहीं बताया। सिर्फ़ कबीर को इशारा किया — और वो समझ गया।
narration.en: I didn't tell anyone. I only signalled Kabir — and he understood.

narration.hi: दीवार पर एक निशान था। तीन रेखाएँ, एक गोलाई... जैसे कोई पुरानी भाषा मेरा नाम बुला रही हो।
narration.en: There was a mark on the wall. Three lines, one circle… as if some old language were calling my name.

narration.hi: सीढ़ियाँ नीचे जाती थीं। हवा ठंडी थी, और अंधेरे में भी कुछ चमक रहा था।
narration.en: The stairs went down. The air was cold, and even in the dark something was shining.

shots.cam: Exterior, height 1.55 m, side-on to the old wing's north wall, the group far background frame-right
shots.move: Slow lateral track right, following the two of them along the wall.
shots.action: Ishaan tilts his head — Kabir looks, follows the look, and grins. They drift sideways away from the group, casual as thieves. Kabir opens the bag and shows the toy car; Ishaan takes it out and pockets it (P-04).
shots.expr: Conspiratorial joy. Kabir mouths something; Ishaan shushes him with one finger.
shots.env: Old wing north wall, gravel, wind-bent grass, a rusted drainpipe.
shots.light: Sun now behind the building: the wall is in shade, the boys half-lit by bounce.
shots.cont: P-04 appears here — the red toy car. If it's absent, the audience will notice the missing payoff in Episode 2. Do not drop it. PROPOSED (non-canon): Ishaan pocketing the toy as a lucky charm.

shots.cam: Exterior, height 1.35 m, low, close on the stone at shoulder height
shots.move: Static. Dust is wiped away by a hand entering from frame-right.
shots.action: A hand sweeps the dust off the stone. Underneath: a carved geometric sigil — three concentric arcs, a bisecting line, and a central circle, all cut shallow into the stone.
shots.env: Weathered sandstone, mortar lines, lichen in the grooves, chisel marks visible at the edges.
shots.light: Flat shade, then a thin sliver of warm light catches the carving from the left and defines it.
shots.vfx: Dust falling. No glow yet — the symbol is just a carving. Restraint is the whole point.
shots.cont: SIGIL LOCK: three arcs + one bisecting line + one circle. This exact geometry is the series' mark. It reappears on the floor of the Core chamber in S13-06. Never simplify or embellish it.

shots.cam: Exterior, height 1.50 m, 3/4 behind Ishaan, Kabir just behind his right shoulder
shots.move: Static; the stone responds — a 6-frame mechanical shift, then stillness.
shots.action: Ishaan's fingers trace the outer arc. A hairline of blue light traces the groove he touched. Both boys go very still. Kabir's hand closes on Ishaan's shoulder.
shots.expr: Awe and fear in the same face, in that order, in three seconds.
shots.env: The wall, the sigil at chest height, the boarded window frame-left.
shots.light: The blue now lights their faces from below — the first time the film's key light comes from inside a wall.
shots.vfx: VFX HERO SHOT 2: light travels the groove like liquid in a channel, 0.6 s, then settles to a steady 20% glow. Volumetric bloom kept to a 2-px radius.
shots.vo: Silence. No narration over the discovery. This is the audience's moment alone.
shots.cont: Blue intensity locked at 20% here, 40% at S12-04, 60% at S12-05, 100% at S13-06 — a deliberate four-step escalation across the act.

shots.cam: Exterior, height 1.60 m, wide enough to hold both boys and a 3 m section of wall
shots.move: Static. The wall section sinks and slides back 40 cm, then stops — no whoosh, no dust cloud.
shots.action: A section of stonework recesses and grinds sideways, revealing a descending stairwell. Cold air moves their hair. Ishaan looks at Kabir. Kabir looks at the stairs.
shots.expr: Terror and invitation. Kabir's grin returns first.
shots.env: The opening: a meter-wide rectangle of black in a sunlit wall, stone steps going down, a smell we cannot see but must believe.
shots.light: Daylight outside vs absolute darkness inside; a faint blue wash rising from below the stair head.
shots.vfx: Cold vapour rolling out over the threshold — ground fog, 4 cm deep. Stone dust settling. Corroborating weight in the stone's motion.
shots.cont: The opening is 1 m wide × 2 m high, in the north wall, 4 m from the boarded window. Architectural geometry must be consistent inside and out.

shots.cam: Interior of the stairwell, height 1.70 m, from above and behind, looking down at their backs
shots.move: Slow descending follow, steadicam, matching their pace — 0.5 m/s, never faster.
shots.action: They descend shoulder to shoulder, Kabir's hand flat on the stone wall as a guide. Ishaan counts steps under his breath. Their breathing becomes visible.
shots.expr: Faces barely lit; we read them by posture and one reflected highlight each.
shots.env: Stone spiral-ish stair, 60 cm steps, hand-cut, a low corbel ceiling, walls wet with condensation.
shots.light: Blue from below at 60%, warm daylight dying behind them at the top of frame — the mouth of the opening slowly losing brightness shot by shot.
shots.vfx: Condensation, breath vapour, light scattering through the blue haze.
shots.cont: Their shadows must fall UP the stairs behind them, toward the daylight. Physically correct, narratively perfect.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.65 m, from inside the corridor looking back at them arriving
shots.move: Static. They step into frame from the stairwell at frame-left and stop.
shots.action: A corridor. Ribbed stone columns, an arched ceiling, inlaid geometric lines running the length of the floor. Blue light bleeds from every groove. They stand at the threshold, absolutely silent.
shots.expr: Two small faces doing the largest possible version of 'what is this place'.
shots.env: L12 approach corridor: 3 m wide, 4 m high, 40 m long, no doors — everything leads to the chamber.
shots.light: Blue-only environment, but with correct falloff: bright at the grooves, dark between them, and a soft overall ambient so the walls stay readable.
shots.vfx: Volumetric haze, slow particle drift, floor reflections that are 30% too coherent to be natural — the architecture is awake.
shots.vo: Line 3 continues; the last words land on the empty corridor ahead of them, not on their faces.
shots.cont: ANCIENT ARCHITECTURE LOCK A-12: no sci-fi greebles, no neon strips, no circuitry. This is stone that predates the building above it. The technology must look carved.
